fcev_battery_policy.source: AKASOL AKASYSTEM 15 OEM 37 PRC, May 2021 manufacturer specification, explicit proxy for 2020 FCEV trucks: 25 kWh, 238 kg, 36 kW continuous charge, 50 kW continuous RMS discharge, 150 kW discharge for 10 s. https://www.act-news.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/210525_LowRes_AK_Datenblatt_AKASystem_15-OEM-37-PRC_2021_2159x2794mm_EN.pdf
fcev_battery_policy.power_boundary: Continuous charging cap after direct auxiliary use; instantaneous cycle discharge bounded by the continuous RMS rating, without repeated pulse assumptions. Rated motor buffer also bounded by the 10-second discharge rating.
fcev_battery_policy.sizing: Maximum of inherited 20 kWh + 6% H2 energy floor, cycle continuous-discharge requirement and rated short-pulse requirement. Explicit capacity retained and validated.
fcev_battery_policy.mass_boundary: Complete pack 238 kg per 25 kWh; 70% cell allocation and NMC-622 manufacture are retained proxies, not measured AKASOL cell specifications.
fcev_battery_policy.limits: Conditioned-pack proxy; no electrothermal, ageing, SOC-window or fuel-cell ramp validation. Generic chemistry costs and replacement assumptions retained.
fcev_battery_policy.lca_proxy: MIX capacity market per nominal kWh including replacements; physical mass mismatch documented without mass-equivalence correction.
fcev_battery_policy.future_hardware: Premise retains the regenerated 2020 FCEV hardware; no runtime cycle simulation.

hev_battery_policy.source: A123 Systems (2014), Battery Pack Design, Validation, and Assembly Guide using A123 Systems Nanophosphate Cells, document 493005-002 Rev 02, Tables 4 and 30-33; AHR32113M1Ultra-B. https://ctc.chontech.ac.th/files/220427099180464_24051016164406.pdf
hev_battery_policy.power_boundary: Full motor discharge rating; excess braking power is curtailed at the pack continuous charge limit
hev_battery_policy.energy_boundary: Periodic finite regenerative buffer, no grid or engine charging; actual stored discharge sets equivalent full cycles
hev_battery_policy.cycle_life_and_cost: Inherited generic chemistry assumptions, not qualified for this high-power cell
hev_battery_policy.lca_proxy: User explicitly retains MIX capacity market and documents physical mass/chemistry mismatch; no mass-equivalence correction

phev_battery_replacement_policy.formula: clip(lifetime km * electric utility factor * electric-mode net stored kJ/km / 3600 / nominal kWh / cycle life - 1, 0, 3)

phev_battery_replacement_policy.energy_boundary: inherited net stored-energy approximation; not gross charge/discharge throughput
phev_battery_replacement_policy.explicit_inputs: nonzero counts retained for the whole pack; conflicting PHEV inputs rejected
